project.name: web
project.productType: agent-facing verification APIs (citations, code, live facts) on Pocket Network

design.colorMode: light (washi) by default; dark (sumi) via the .dark class from next-themes; both from the same token rules

colors.background: var(--background) oklch(0.975 0.006 85) washi · dark oklch(0.16 0.008 260) sumi
colors.accent: var(--primary) 藍 indigo oklch(0.45 0.14 265) · dark oklch(0.72 0.12 265): the only accent, interaction and brand only
colors.verdicts: --verdict-verified 青磁 · --verdict-mismatch 琥珀 · --verdict-not-found 朱 · --verdict-retracted 紅 · --verdict-ambiguous 藤 · --verdict-unknown grey; all ≥ 4.5:1 on background and card (D-024)

typography.display: var(--font-display) Newsreader; one italic word per headline at most
typography.data: var(--font-mono) IBM Plex Mono: verdict codes, receipts, as_of, IDs, JSON; eyebrows uppercase with widest tracking
typography.mark: var(--font-mark) Shippori Mincho B1 800: the 証 mark and the kanji index (典 符 今) only

spacing.ledger row: py-8 between hairlines, dot leaders between name and ID

shadows.receipt: var(--shadow-receipt): the only drop shadow in the app

motion.ease: var(--ease-seal) cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); state changes only, 150–240 ms (--duration-state 180ms)
motion.signature: seal press: scale 1.06 → 1 plus a 120 ms ink bloom when a verdict lands
motion.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion gives cross-fades only; ambient loops pause off-screen

design.density: certificate ledger: hairlines and whitespace do the layout, mono data, no card chrome except the receipt

patterns: Seal and Wordmark from @akashi/brand/react (outlined SVG, currentColor + var(--primary))
a verdict is always glyph + word + colour (packages/brand TONES)

must: Tokens only: no hex, rgb or px literals in TSX; colours through theme utilities or var(--token)
藍 indigo (--primary) is the only accent and never a verdict colour
Verdicts are glyph + word + colour, never colour alone
Dark and light from the same rules (.dark overrides in packages/brand/tokens/theme.css)
Constants, not magic numbers (ESLint @typescript-eslint/no-magic-numbers); files ≤ 400 lines
Real Akashi examples and copy, never lorem ipsum
avoid: round hanko, brush fonts, kanji watermarks
glassmorphism, purple gradients, generic SaaS gradient heroes
Tailwind palette colour utilities (text-blue-500 …) and pasted HTML
drop shadows other than the receipt's

decisions.summary: Brand tokens: light mismatch/ambiguous/unknown darkened (L 0.55/0.55/0.545) so every verdict colour passes AA on washi
One primitive family per app: web uses shadcn radix-nova (21st picks and AI Elements are Radix); docs uses Fumadocs' Base UI build
S7 foundation page: seal + letters-only wordmark in the nav (never 証 twice), Newsreader headline, ledger of the three services with endpoints generated from the OpenAPI
